text:
Alex: Heads-up — need a quick sync on policy ownership + SLA gates for multi-region routing and tenant isolation. Were getting multiple customer asks; want to align on launch criteria and prioritization. Friday 10am OK?
Mira: Context: PM backlog has 3 customers asking for tenant-level isolation + region pinning. Two are enterprise finance/health; theyre asking for SLA 99.9 latency/availability.
Devon: Implementation note: true isolation lanes = separate router pools + dedicated serving capacity per tenant. Large infra cost and adds placement complexity. Soft isolation (affinity + throttles) is cheaper but weaker guarantees.
Sandeep: Customer A (finance) requires VPC + strict routing. We can meet this via Dedicated pools but rollout is ~2 quarters (infra + contracts).
Laura: Draft gating criteria idea: (1) p95 latency < 150ms on pilot; (2) automated config drift audits enabled; (3) canary with 8-10 tenants; (4) documented SLA + legal sign-off.
Alex: @Devon can you ballpark infra delta for per-tenant Dedicated pools vs shared+affinity? Need numbers to take to sales/finance.
Devon: Rough calc: per-tenant Dedicated pools ~2-4x GPU cost depending on utilization profile; shared+affinity ~1.1x with smarter packing. Ill run a quick spreadsheet for three customer scenarios and post link.
Sandeep: Operational requirement: routing fallback policy. If dedicated pool saturated -> fallback to a compatible hosted model variant with degraded SLA and auto-notify customer with TTL for failback. That must be in the playbook.
Mira: Also product/legal: this is a contract-level change (SLA language + liability). PMs need to add a checkbox in sales flow.
Laura: Launch checklist (first draft): infra approval, SLA wording, per-tenant metrics dashboard, rollout playbook, canary tenants identified, automated rollback, runbook, billing changes.
Alex: Decision proposal: prioritize Dedicated pools for top 3 paying customers (sales-led), provide soft-isolation as self-serve for smaller customers. Approve taking the infra delta to finance for committed capacity estimate. Can we get GTM sign-off by EOD?
Devon: oncall-bot: deploy-staging failed for isolation-lane demo -> logs: `allocation error: insufficient gpus`
Devon: Ill requeue with reduced batch size and post updated numbers.
Mira: :thumbsup: Ill sync with the PMs and draft the customer-facing note.
Alex: Thanks — agenda for sync: ownership matrix (infra/product/ops/security), exact SLA language, fallback semantics, pilot tenant list, rough cost estimates.
Mira: I'll put a short doc in the architecture drive and invite stakeholders.
Laura: Adding runbooks + metrics to the doc.
Sandeep: FYI: also prepare an emergency quarantine play for noisy tenants.
Alex: Perfect — see you Friday 10am.
